title: GeneAgent: self-verification language agent for gene-set analysis using domain databases
expertise_informed_reason: The publication and official repository support autonomous database queries, retained verification reports, revision of unsupported claims, benchmark comparison, expert assessment, and replay materials. The original coding is retained.

title: scAgent: Agentic Universal Single-Cell Annotation
evaluated_use_case: Cross-tissue cell annotation, novel-cell discovery, and incremental learning of new cell types
expertise_informed_reason: The paper and public implementation support planning, specialist modules, memory, checkpoints, linked data, and cross-tissue evaluation. E6 is recoded NR because scRNA-seq measurements are covered by E3 and no separate runtime experimental or clinical-observation channel is clearly demonstrated.

title: ProtAgents: protein discovery via large language model multi-agent collaborations combining physics and machine learning
evaluated_use_case: Multi-agent protein design and analysis combining retrieval, generative models, structural analysis and physics simulation
expertise_informed_reason: The paper and repository support specialized multi-agent collaboration, retrieval, protein generation, structural analysis, learned-model outputs, physics simulation, and public experiment notebooks. The original coding, including F5=U and cumulative V2, is retained.

title: PathAgent: Toward Interpretable Analysis of Whole-slide Pathology Images via Large Language Model-based Agentic Reasoning
evaluated_use_case: Autonomous multi-magnification whole-slide navigation and evidence-grounded pathology visual question answering
expertise_informed_reason: The paper and repository support adaptive WSI navigation, evolving evidence traces, coordinated modules, evaluation code, multi-dataset testing, and pathologist assessment. E6 is recoded NR because WSI inputs belong to E3 and pathologist review is treated as validation qualifier H rather than runtime Evidence E6.

title: Accelerating Scientific Discovery with Autonomous Goal-evolving Agents
evaluated_use_case: Bi-level autonomous evolution of scientific objectives and optimization of antibiotic and nanobody designs
expertise_informed_reason: The paper and repository strongly support adaptive objective evolution, executable scoring functions, corrective updates, replay materials, and prospective antibiotic and nanobody experiments. E2 is recoded U because a knowledge-management component is present, but a distinct structured biological knowledgebase or ontology used as runtime evidence is not explicit.

title: STELLA: Towards a Biomedical World Model with Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents
evaluated_use_case: Self-evolving tool creation, AML target discovery, enzyme directed evolution, and vision-language-action laboratory automation.
expertise_informed_reason: The preprint and repository support multi-agent coordination, critic feedback, dynamic tool creation, reusable templates, packaged execution assets, benchmarks, and prospective experiments. The original full Functionality, full Evidence, and cumulative V4 coding is retained.
